title: Rare missense variants identified by whole-genome sequencing in men with oligoasthenoteratozoospermia: An experimental study.
authors: Sadeghzadeh, Sara; Malcher, Agnieszka; Ebrahimi Askari, Razieh; Sefid, Fatemeh; Ibrahim, Rim; Pastuszak, Krzysztof; Srivastava, Aashish; Dehghani, Mohammadreza; Vahidi, Serajoddin; Lotfi, Marzieh; Ghasemi, Nasrin; Kurpisz, Maciej
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过全基因组测序鉴定少弱畸形精子症相关罕见错义变异，并利用AlphaFold等工具进行蛋白结构建模分析，虽涉及蛋白质结构预测但核心是临床遗传学而非蛋白质结构计算问题。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Oligoasthenoteratozoospermia (OAT) is a major cause of male infertility, characterized by low sperm count, poor motility, and abnormal morphology. While genetic factors contribute to a substantial proportion of cases, the specific variants underlying OAT remain largely unknown, especially in populations with high rates of consanguinity. OBJECTIVE: To identify rare candidate variants potentially associated with OAT using whole-genome sequencing (WGS) in 7 men from consanguineous families. MATERIALS AND METHODS: 7 men with OAT from consanguineous families, with normal karyotypes and no Y-chromosome microdeletions, were selected. WGS was performed, and variants were called using DeepVariant. These variants were then annotated using the Ensembl variant effect predictor. Rare variants were prioritized based on their predicted pathogenicity and relevance to reproduction, and candidate variants were validated. Protein structure modeling and analysis of mutation-induced effects on molecular interactions were carried out using Swiss model and AlphaFold. RESULTS: We identified 2 rare homozygous missense variants in DNAH9 (p.Pro355Leu) and CFAP45 (p.Arg493Trp) in the index case with OAT. Both genes have been implicated in sperm flagellar structure and motility. Additional variants in genes associated with spermiogenesis, acrosomal integrity, and testicular function were also identified. CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate the potential utility of WGS in identifying rare candidate variants potentially associated with OAT. The identified DNAH9 and CFAP45 variants, together with additional candidate variants, may contribute to the impaired sperm function observed in this man. This study also highlights the value of genome-wide analyses in improving our understanding of male infertility, particularly in consanguineous populations, and provides a foundation for future functional studies and personalized diagnostic approaches.
abstract_zh: 背景：少弱畸形精子症（OAT）是男性不育的主要原因，其特征为精子数量低、活力差和形态异常。尽管遗传因素在相当比例的病例中起作用，但OAT背后的具体变异仍 largely 未知，尤其是在近亲结婚率较高的人群中。目的：利用全基因组测序（WGS）在来自近亲家庭的7名男性中识别可能与OAT相关的罕见候选变异。材料与方法：选取7名来自近亲家庭、核型正常且无Y染色体微缺失的OAT男性。进行WGS，并使用DeepVariant进行变异检测。随后使用Ensembl变异效应预测器对这些变异进行注释。基于预测的致病性和与生殖的相关性对罕见变异进行优先排序，并验证候选变异。使用Swiss model和AlphaFold进行蛋白质结构建模及突变对分子相互作用影响的分析。结果：在索引病例中，我们识别出DNAH9（p.Pro355Leu）和CFAP45（p.Arg493Trp）中的2个罕见纯合错义变异。这两个基因均与精子鞭毛结构和运动性有关。还识别出与精子发生、顶体完整性和睾丸功能相关的基因中的其他变异。结论：我们的发现证明了WGS在识别可能与OAT相关的罕见候选变异方面的潜在效用。所识别的DNAH9和CFAP45变异，连同其他候选变异，可能有助于该男性观察到的精子功能受损。本研究还强调了全基因组分析在增进我们对男性不育理解中的价值，特别是在近亲人群中，并为未来的功能研究和个性化诊断方法奠定了基础。
